service.en: Refund or transfer a utility account balance
service.ar: استرداد رصيد حساب المرافق أو تحويله
service.ur: یوٹیلیٹی اکاؤنٹ بیلنس کی واپسی یا منتقلی

about: Ask for a credit balance to be refunded after closing a utility account, or moved to another account.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Emirates ID of the account holder
Power of attorney and the agent's Emirates ID, if someone applies on the holder's behalf
For companies: official company letter, economic licence and signature authorisation
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app) or another available channel
